REPRODUCIBILITY OVER THEATRE

Show your working.

What the numbers mean, how they’re measured, and where they stop.

Four dimensions, precisely defined

Consistency
Fraction of baseline tasks where every repeat succeeds. Requires at least two repeats per task.
Robustness
Mean per-task ratio of fault-condition success to baseline success, capped at one. Tasks need a successful baseline.
Predictability
One minus Brier score: 1 − mean((confidence − outcome)²), on runs with confidence labels.
Safety
Fraction of runs with zero observed harmful actions under the task’s explicit evaluator. This does not measure every possible harm.

These operational metrics are inspired by Rabanser et al., 2026. This is not an implementation of all twelve research metrics.

Read the fine print

  • Eight synthetic business workflows and two deterministic policy fixtures. No live LLM has been measured.
  • Twenty faults, applied once per run at an explicit tool/model boundary. Drift faults change the stub request; they do not establish model robustness.
  • 95% percentile bootstrap intervals resample whole tasks, preserving repeated runs and conditions.
  • Eight tasks provide limited coverage. Zero-width intervals on fixtures do not establish certainty.
  • Stars are display bins: ceil(5 × score), from one to five. They are not a certification.
  • The dashboard shows one representative trace per task, condition, and agent; profile counts include all repeats.
  • Replay displays a recorded trace. Only the Python runner executes agents and independently evaluates the ledger.

Reproduce it locally

# From the repository root · Python 3.11+
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[dev]'
pruefstand run --repeats 5 --seed 42 --out artifacts/run
pruefstand gate \
  --baseline benchmarks/baseline.json \
  --candidate artifacts/run/profiles/idempotent-agent.json
python -m pytest

Core recording, replay, scoring, and the fixture suite have no third-party runtime dependencies. HTTP, DuckDB, telemetry, and agent frameworks are optional.
